reviews.comment: SO MUCH WORK Assignments are so unnecessarily tedious, and she expects them to be perfectly formatted to how she wants them without providing any instructions. Takes off points for way to many things, im a A student but its extremely hard to get an A in her courses. I spent like 8 hrs a week on just homework for this class, it feels never-ending!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Completed every assignment and attended regularly, yet still failed. This class demands excessive time, more than my hardest STEM courses, and leaves no room for a social life. Communication is poor; emails go unanswered. If possible, take this credit elsewhere. Avoid if you value your time.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She didn't grade anything until after our final project was due in December. I still have things from August ungraded. She gave hardly any feedback but expected us to grow. On several of my *few* graded assignments, I have an imperfect score with no feedback on why I lost points. She also never responded to any emails.

Prof. Payne has to be one of the nicest professors I have ever had. You do have to participate and complete the assignments, but as long as you do that you are basically guaranteed a good grade. She grades easy, but also provides great feedback, so you still learn a lot! Definitely the best ENGL professor at TAMU.

SUPER sweet prof. Class is essentially a seminar so participation matters. 4min quiz over the reading (4 books, 3 movies) every class, but she drops 2. 4 papers, but aren't difficult to write. As long as you're a friednly face to her and talk about the readings in class and apply them to your papers, you'll do just fine. 3 tests, but they're easy
